description: answers four questions from the ADW object trace with evidence: the latest Notes update, where a task stopped, an object's state and error, and whether content saved and the browser rendered that version
notes: Toyota's profile maps this name to adapters/inspection_runner.ObjectInspectionRunner, which calls object_trace.service on 127.0.0.1:8790 (/api/ask/<question>) with no model in the path. adapters/inspection_route.ObjectInspectionRoute forces the route for the four questions. Read-only: it never writes the trace or the Notes.
